title: loadout-note metadata block
description: The JSON payload embedded in a fenced ```loadout-note``` block appended to a comment/PR body by clagentic_loadout.transport.note_compose.build_composed_body — the tool-owned, general-purpose counterpart to merge.verdict's review-result fence. Carries an OPTIONAL opaque caller-tracking-id (a work-item ref meaningful to the calling deployment, e.g. a task id) through to the posted comment's metadata without the caller ever having to hand-author a fence, a heredoc, or a $VAR-substituted redirect target in a shell command. Field set is deliberately minimal and additive: this block is not a merge-gate contract (see review-result.schema.json for that) and carries no enforcement semantics of its own.

caller_tracking_id.description: Opaque work-item tracking id supplied by the caller (e.g. a lore task id for a LORE-integrated deployment, or any other deployment's own tracking-id shape). This schema does not constrain its format beyond non-empty -- the pattern is caller-owned, never baked into loadout product code (CLAUDE.md rule 6a).
